name: Sheep Milk
siboNotes: Lower lactose content than cow's milk makes it potentially better tolerated by some SIBO patients. Start with small amounts to assess individual tolerance.
preparationTips: Use in small amounts as a coffee creamer or in recipes
Consider warming gently to aid digestion
Pair with lactase enzyme if lactose sensitive
Store properly refrigerated and use within 3-5 days of opening
nutritionalHighlights: Higher protein content than cow's milk
